mechanism_narrative: The sharp fall in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals a broad demand shock that suppresses discretionary trips to shops and restaurants. If these two series remain deeply negative, RETAIL_REC will stay lower over the next four weeks than over the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior 4-week mean while TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both remain below -40 for the next four weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL jumps above +30, households substitute toward staying home and reduce shopping visits within one to two weeks. The current surge in home presence will therefore pull RETAIL_REC down over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 14 days after RESIDENTIAL stays above +30 for at least one full week.

mechanism_narrative: A joint collapse in GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS indicates fewer routine out-of-home errands and fewer leisure outings, which spills over into weaker retail traffic over the next month. The combined drop should precede lower RETAIL_REC.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not below its prior 4-week mean over the next 28 days despite GROCERY_PHARM and PARKS both staying negative.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT falls by more than 10 points from one week to the next, it marks a mobility tightening that quickly cuts walk-in retail visits. The effect should show up within one week as weaker RETAIL_REC.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not weaken in the week after a TRANSIT drop greater than 10 points.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both sit below -50 at the same time, commuting compression overwhelms incidental shopping trips and retail demand falls further. Under that joint low-mobility regime, RETAIL_REC will decline over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC holds steady or rises over the next 28 days while both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT remain below -50.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS during warm-weather leisure substitution shifts discretionary time away from shopping centers and toward outdoor activity. That pattern should reduce RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while PARKS remains above its baseline and continues rising.

mechanism_narrative: If GROCERY_PHARM turns positive while RESIDENTIAL remains elevated, households are making only essential trips and suppressing discretionary shopping. That mix should keep RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 14 days when GROCERY_PHARM stays positive and RESIDENTIAL stays above +20.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in TRANSIT from deeply negative levels signals easing access to city centers, which should bring retail footfall back after a short lag. If TRANSIT recovers toward zero, RETAIL_REC will improve over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 15 points from its current level
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its prior 4-week mean over the next 14 days despite a TRANSIT rebound of at least 15 points.
